description: This file contains shell functions and logic for managing firmware upgrades on Buffalo devices. It includes procedures for verifying images, handling UBI/Trx-specific upgrade steps, and interacting with MTD partitions.

methods.name: buffalo_check_image
methods.description: Validates the firmware image for compatibility and correctness based on size, format, and device specifics.

methods.name: buffalo_upgrade_ubinized
methods.description: Handles upgrading using TRX + UBI formatted images, including detachment and erasure of MTD partition.

methods.name: buffalo_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade function that determines image type and invokes the appropriate upgrade procedure.
